title: Conceded Rent under a Retention Concession, Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
The new rent of a retention concession on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement is the increase's rent as it stands less a give-back of the class's retention share of the increase, rounded down to the cent.

## Definitions

- **The increase's rent as it stands** — the new rent of the reduction notice pointing at the increase where one is on file, and otherwise the increase's own new rent. The increase is the agreement's latest existing-customer rate increase notice.
- **The increase** — that rent less the rent before the increase recorded on the increase notice.
- **Retention share** — the class's retention share.
- **Give-back** — the retention share of the increase, rounded down to the cent.
- **New rent** — the increase's rent as it stands less the give-back.

## Worked figures (hypothetical class with a 50% retention share)

| Rent before | Increase notice new rent | Reduction notice on file | Rent as it stands | Increase | Give-back | New rent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $150.00 | $168.00 | none | $168.00 | $18.00 | $9.00 | $159.00 |
| $150.00 | $175.00 | $165.00 | $165.00 | $15.00 | $7.50 | $157.50 |
| $110.00 | $127.25 | none | $127.25 | $17.25 | $8.62 (from $8.625, rounded down) | $118.63 |
